certification.name: Red Team Specialist
certification.description: Red team certification covering end-to-end operations against Active Directory, AD CS, Exchange, SSO, MFA and VDI across segmented networks. Assessed by a 24-hour open-book practical exam after a 30-day practice lab.
certification.currency_note: Includes course material, 30 days of practice lab access and two exam attempts; lower promotional prices are frequent
